grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
ref-defs-PixelPolygon ::= "{" space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-kind-kv "," space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-kv space "}"
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-kind ::= "\"polygon\""
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-kind-kv ::= "\"kind\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-kind
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points ::= "[" space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item ("," space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item){2,31} space "]"
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item ::= "[" space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item-coordinate-0 "," space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item-coordinate-1 space "]"
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item-coordinate-0 ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-item-coordinate-1 ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points-kv ::= "\"points\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelPolygon-points
ref-defs-PixelRectangle ::= "{" space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-kind-kv "," space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x0-kv "," space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y0-kv "," space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x1-kv "," space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y1-kv space "}"
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-kind ::= "\"rectangle\""
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-kind-kv ::= "\"kind\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-kind
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x0 ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x0-kv ::= "\"x0\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x0
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x1 ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x1-kv ::= "\"x1\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-x1
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y0 ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y0-kv ::= "\"y0\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y0
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y1 ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y1-kv ::= "\"y1\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PixelRectangle-y1
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-observation-id-kv "," space response-format-schema-artifact-id-kv "," space response-format-schema-source-sha256-kv "," space response-format-schema-width-kv "," space response-format-schema-height-kv "," space response-format-schema-status-kv "," space response-format-schema-regions-kv "," space response-format-schema-evidence-kv "," space response-format-schema-uncertainties-kv space "}"
response-format-schema-artifact-id ::= "\"" char+ "\""
response-format-schema-artifact-id-kv ::= "\"artifact_id\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-artifact-id
response-format-schema-evidence ::= "\"" char+ "\""
response-format-schema-evidence-kv ::= "\"evidence\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-evidence
response-format-schema-height ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
response-format-schema-height-kv ::= "\"height\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-height
response-format-schema-observation-id ::= "\"" char+ "\""
response-format-schema-observation-id-kv ::= "\"observation_id\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-observation-id
response-format-schema-regions ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-regions-item ("," space response-format-schema-regions-item){0,3})? space "]"
response-format-schema-regions-item ::= (response-format-schema-regions-item-alternative-0 | response-format-schema-regions-item-alternative-1)
response-format-schema-regions-item-alternative-0 ::= ref-defs-PixelRectangle
response-format-schema-regions-item-alternative-1 ::= ref-defs-PixelPolygon
response-format-schema-regions-kv ::= "\"regions\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-regions
response-format-schema-source-sha256 ::= "\"" [0-9a-f]{64} "\""
response-format-schema-source-sha256-kv ::= "\"source_sha256\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-source-sha256
response-format-schema-status ::= ("\"located\"" | "\"unlocatable\"")
response-format-schema-status-kv ::= "\"status\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-status
response-format-schema-uncertainties ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-uncertainties-item ("," space response-format-schema-uncertainties-item){0,7})? space "]"
response-format-schema-uncertainties-item ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-uncertainties-kv ::= "\"uncertainties\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-uncertainties
response-format-schema-width ::= ([0-9] | [1-9] [0-9]{1,6} | [1-3] [0-9]{7} | "40000000")
response-format-schema-width-kv ::= "\"width\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-width
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Defer only sampler string maxLength; retain all complete source schema bytes and SHA binding
transformation.unchanged: JSON types, exact keys, required members, enum, string minLength and every array minItems/maxItems
transformation.method: Deterministic GBNF for the exact source-reading or localization consumer; fixed integer bounds, polygon/rectangle alternatives, coordinate tuples and array bounds are retained.
transformation.length_scope: Only string maxLength is omitted from sampler GBNF to avoid the installed 6703d7894 repetition parser boundary. String minLength and all array minItems/maxItems remain enforced by this grammar. The complete original schema, text system/prompt and host Pydantic retain every string maximum; overlong responses must be rejected without truncation or repair.
transformation.input_scope: One unchanged bound original PNG; identity, SHA, dimensions and geometry are revalidated by bind_localization and rasterize_localization
